title: Lipschitz approximation lemma (Simon 5.2.6, contract normalization)
statement: For n >= 1, l, p > n there are beta in (0,1/4] and C, depending only on n,l,p, such that for all L in (0,1], K >= 0, open U, V with generalized mean curvature H, delta, rho with 0 < delta <= (beta L)^(2n+2) and AllardHypotheses H p delta rho, and every linear isometry q of R^(n+l) such that dist(x, T_0) <= K delta^(1/(2n+2)) delta rho for all x in spt V cap B_{2 delta rho}(0), where T_0 := q(R^n x {0}), there is f: R^n -> R^l, L-Lipschitz on B^n_{delta rho/2}(0), with |f| <= K delta^(1/(2n+2)) delta rho there and mu_V(B_{delta rho/2}(0) cap (spt V minus q(graph f over B^n_{delta rho/2}))) + H^n(B_{delta rho/2}(0) cap (q(graph f over B^n_{delta rho/2}) minus spt V)) <= C L^-2 integral_{B_{delta rho}(0)} |p_{T_xM} - p_{T_0}|^2 dmu_V.
